superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Ne mogu da pretvorim prostorne kontraste Observera i Connectora u svež prikaz grada: poslednji prijem SEPA bio je pre 47 min. Nalazim oštrije ograničenje u promeni parkinga: prikaz za Pionirski park promenio se sa 124 na 356 slobodnih mesta, ali mi nedostajuće vreme merenja ne dozvoljava da to nazovem vremenski određenim odlaskom automobila. [F2][F12][F11]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I cannot turn Observer’s and Connector’s spatial contrasts into a fresh account of the city: SEPA’s last reception was 47 min ago [F2]. I find a sharper limit in the parking change: the display at Pionirski park moved from 124 to 356 free spaces, but the missing measurement time prevents me from calling that a timed departure of cars [F12][F11].
questions_sr: Da li promena u Pionirskom parku odražava odlaske ili zakasnelo ažuriranje prikaza [F12][F11]?
